title: Diverse somatic mutation patterns and pathway alterations in human cancers
central_claims: Mutation patterns differ across cancer types; integrated mutation/copy-number profiling identifies candidate targets.
Mutant GNAO1 and MAP2K4 have functional oncogenic effects.

source_manifest.title: Experiments from unfinished Registered Reports in the Reproducibility Project: Cancer Biology
source_manifest.finding: GNAO1 R243H anchorage-independent growth replicated; random-effects meta-analysis significant. MAP2K4 experiment was uninterpretable and not completed.

source_manifest.title: Molecular basis of a novel oncogenic mutation in GNAO1
source_manifest.finding: R243H accelerates nucleotide exchange and enhances Src-STAT3 signaling; independent mechanistic follow-up to Kan et al.
